teaser: A closed notebook waits by your elbow more often than it opens. You are a 7, a life path built on solitude and inquiry, and an INFP, a temperament built on feeling and meaning — and in you those two withdrawals double each other. The world asks for small talk; you are somewhere else, turning a question over until it has an edge. This crossing does not produce someone cold. It produces someone who disappears into thought the way others disappear into a hobby, and comes back changed by it, rarely saying how.
excerpt: The hum of a long bus ride fills the silence where talk might otherwise go, and a partner beside you learns not to fill it either.
